# Combo Box

Select one or multiple options in a large list, either by typing a value directly or by choosing inside the list.
See <a className="sbk-link" href="https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/combo-box/design/" target="_blank">ComboBox guidelines<i className="mat-icon">launch</i></a>

### When to use

To select a single value in a small list, consider using the <LinkTo kind="Components/Select" story="docs">Select</LinkTo> component instead.

<Canvas of={ComboboxStories.Basic} />

```css
.w-288 {
  width: 288px;
}
.h-224 {
  height: 224px;
}
```
